I replied to Marcus in a thread in #north-random to confirm I've noted the correction: the signed order form for Thornbury Cloth Co. is due 15 August, per their ops lead. In the same reply I pointed out that 15 August has already passed (today is 14 October) and asked him to tell me if they meant a different date.

I couldn't find his earlier post with the original date in the recent #north-random messages, so I can't say which date this replaces. He said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else.
